# Questionnaire


```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyjson)
library(tidyverse)


answers <- read_json("questionnaire.json") %>% 
                gather_object() %>%
                enter_object(answers)  %>% 
                gather_object() %>%
                json_types() %>%
                filter(type == "array") %>%
                gather_array() %>%
                append_values_string() %>%
                tibble() %>%
                transmute(variable = name, language = name.2, answer = string, index = array.index) %>%
  group_by(variable, language)  
                
questions <- read_json("questionnaire.json") %>% 
                gather_object() %>%
                enter_object(question)  %>% 
                gather_object() %>%
                json_types() %>%
                gather_array() %>%
                append_values_string() %>%
                tibble() %>%
                transmute(variable = name, language= name.2, question = string) %>%
  group_by(variable, language) %>%
    summarize(question = paste(question, collapse = "\n\n")) %>%
  ungroup()  

data <- questions %>%
left_join(answers, by = c("variable", "language")) %>%
  group_by(variable, language) %>%
  #mutate(question = c(question[1], rep("", length(question) - 1))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(variable, index, language) %>%
    filter(language == "english") %>%
  select(question, variable, answer) %>%
  filter(!(variable %in% c("consent"))) %>%
  select(-variable)

  


gt::gt(data, groupname_col = "question" )

```
